# Disagreement Log — GTH_092

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 92
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 92 | "Seek" | "Seek" | "Keep searching" | Seeking verb: simple imperative vs. continuous |
| 2 | 92 | "in former times" | "in those days" | "once" | Temporal reference to prior period |
| 3 | 92 | "I desire to tell it" | "I am willing to tell it" | "I want to tell you" | *thelo*: desire vs. willing vs. want |
| 4 | 92 | "you do not inquire" | "you are not asking" | "you're not even asking" | Absence of seeking: inquire vs. ask |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "Seek," "former times," "I desire to tell," and "you do not inquire" (consistent with Thomas's seeking vocabulary).
